battle.name: 法蘭西之戰
battle.brief: 一九四〇年五月十日德軍自阿登突破法軍戴爾計畫的前線，六週之內迫使法國簽下停戰書。卡面的 B1 重戰車 B1 bis 是法軍裝甲預備隊的骨幹：裝甲集中使用、通信與預備隊的位置，比「誰的戰車更厚」更快決定缺口。

kit.name: B1 重戰車
kit.history: 裝甲厚、車體 75 砲加砲塔 47 砲。單人砲塔讓車長過載——結構問題，不是士氣問題。

countries: 法蘭西第三共和國一方，國政由總統阿爾貝・勒布倫主持，軍權最高由總參謀長加勉掌握，五月十九日加勉去職後由魏剛接任，戰區編制是「東北部戰線集團軍」，由朱安中將統轄，旗下分第一軍（于蒂格）守最北段、第二軍（普雷韋爾）守索姆河中段、第三軍接阿爾卑斯方向，裝甲師與騎兵軍列為總預備。法軍開戰時有九十四個師，五十六個師配在北部，正面對著二十六個德軍師，二十二個師固守阿爾卑斯山防線對義大利，十六個師留作總預備；本土補充兵與來自北非、塞內加爾的殖民地部隊陸續開到，總動員到六月中旬約二百六十萬人（各書統計在二百萬至二百六十萬之間）。英國以遠征軍參戰，陸軍由戈特勳爵指揮，駐法部隊編為英軍第一、二、三軍，另派機械化騎兵旅與獨立戰車營；英軍航空隊在本土攔截德軍，皇家海軍則在敦刻爾克執行撤退輸送。比利時由萊奧波德三世國王主持抵抗至五月二十八日投降，荷蘭軍抵抗至五月十四日，荷蘭皇家海軍為免艦艇被奪，於五月十四日與十五日在艾伊莫伊登與丹赫爾兩地自行沉船。德國方面由倫德施泰特主持西部戰區，戰術指揮分屬博克的A集團軍群與勒布的C集團軍群，最精銳的裝甲兵集中在克萊斯特裝甲集群與古德里安第十九軍團，另有賴歇瑙第七軍、霍特第九軍在南部與中部牽制；義大利軍於六月十日自阿爾卑斯方向投入攻勢。整體上形成北、中、南三面同時施壓、而法軍把預備隊擠在比利時境內的態勢。
countriesEn: On the French side, the Third Republic was headed by President Albert Lebrun, while supreme military power rested with the Chief of the General Staff, Gamelin, who was replaced by Weygand on 19 May. The theatre organisation was the Army Group of the North-East, commanded by General Alphonse Juin, subdivided into the First Army under Huntziger on the northernmost stretch, the Second Army under Prévert on the middle of the Somme, and the Third Army covering the Alpine flank, with the armoured divisions and the cavalry corps held back as general reserve. The French army fielded ninety-four divisions on 10 May: fifty-six of them in the north facing twenty-six German divisions, twenty-two in the Alpine fortifications against Italy, and sixteen in general reserve. Conscripts from metropolitan France and colonial troops from North Africa and Senegal arrived as the weeks went by, and total mobilisation reached roughly 2.6 million men by mid-June, with published estimates ranging from two million to 2.6 million. Britain entered with the British Expeditionary Force under Lord Gort, its forces in France organised as the First, Second and Third British Armies, with armoured car brigades and Independent Tank Companies attached; the British air force intercepted the Germans over Britain, and the Royal Navy carried out the evacuation from Dunkirk. Belgium fought under King Leopold III and its general headquarters until the capitulation of 28 May, while the Dutch army resisted until 14 May; the Royal Dutch Navy, to keep its ships from being seized, scuttled them at IJmuiden on 14 May and at Den Helder on 15 May. On the German side the Western theatre was run by Rundstedt, with operational command split between von Bock's Army Group B and von Leeb's Army Group C. The best armoured troops were concentrated in Kleist's Panzergruppe and Guderian's XIX Army Corps, with Reichenau's Seventh Army and Hoth's Ninth Army providing the pin on the southern and central sectors. The Italian army entered the offensive from the Alpine front on 10 June. The overall shape of the campaign was therefore pressure from north, centre and south at once, with the French reserves pushed forward into Belgium.
people: 加勉是這場戰爭頭一個月的法軍最高指揮官，他堅持未經一戰便不肯放棄法國的榮譽，把戴爾計畫當作唯一可行方案，卻拒絕在德軍尚未充分展開時集中反攻；五月十九日德軍已越過梅茲河、裝甲部隊直指英吉利海峽之際，他仍在北面推動比法聯軍繼續抵抗，最後在與魏剛會面後去職。魏剛接任後提出「打到敦刻爾克」，把注意力集中在保住法國北部軍力並把英軍與法軍主力一同撤出歐陸，他也在停戰談判的關鍵時刻被解除職務。東北部戰線集團軍司令朱安是裝甲部隊真正的使用權威，五月十九日以後他下令裝甲師在索姆河與埃納河一線集結反攻，卻始終只能分批投入戰鬥。裝甲師長卡圖在色丹一線的抵抗最為著名，他率第四裝甲師以 B1 bis 與 R35 頂住古德里安的戰車兵團數日，十九日突圍時被俘。德軍方面，曼施泰因提出的「鋼盔」方案把突破點壓在色丹，裝甲兵出身的古德里安以第十九軍團執行突破，十三日奪得梅茲河大橋後連發戰報，主張乘勝追擊；他與元首在戰術節奏上屢起爭執，最後仍以戰車不停頓、往英吉利海峽直插為準。隆美爾指揮第七軍團在索姆河與阿米安一線高速推進，五月二十日兵鋒抵達蒙迪迪耶與亞伯維爾。戴高樂在五月十八日廣播中號召繼續抵抗，倡導「自由法軍」；貝當在六月十七日出任總理，十八日宣布停戰談判，並在停戰書上簽了字。
peopleEn: Gamelin was the French supreme commander for the first month of the war. Insisting that France must not surrender her honour without a battle, he treated the Dyle Plan as the only workable option and refused to concentrate for a counter-offensive while the Germans were not yet fully deployed. On 19 May, with the German army already across the Meuse and its panzers driving for the Channel, he was still pushing the Anglo-French forces in the north to keep fighting, and he was removed from office only after meeting Weygand. Weygand took over with the slogan of fighting to Dunkirk, concentrating on preserving the French armies in the north and on getting the British and the bulk of the French army off the continent; he too was dismissed at the decisive moment of the armistice negotiations. Alphonse Juin, commanding the North-East Army Group, was the real authority on the employment of the armoured forces, and after 19 May he ordered the armoured divisions to concentrate for counter-attacks along the Somme and the Aisne, yet he could only ever commit them in dribs and drabs. The most famous resistance on the Sedan front was that of the armoured division commander Catroux, who held with B1 bis and R35 tanks against Guderian's panzer force for several days and was captured on 19 May when his position was overrun. On the German side, Manstein's Sichelschnitt plan pressed the breakthrough onto Sedan, and the tank officer Guderian carried it out with the XIX Army Corps, sending back report after report after taking the Meuse bridges on 13 May and urging the pursuit; he and the Führer argued repeatedly over the tempo, and in the end the decision for the tanks not to pause and to drive for the Channel stood. Rommel, commanding the Seventh Army Corps, advanced at speed along the Somme and around Amiens, his spearhead reaching Montdidier and Abbeville on 20 May. De Gaulle broadcast on 18 May calling for continued resistance and proposed a Free French; Pétain became prime minister on 17 June, announced armistice negotiations on the 18th, and signed the armistice himself.
kits: 卡面的 B1 重戰車即 Char B1 bis（B1 bis S35），法國在一九三六年到三七年把 B1 原始型加長車體、加重裝甲後的量產重型戰車：全重約三十二噸，車體正面裝甲最厚八十毫米、側壁四十至五十毫米，砲塔正面六十至八十毫米，裝一門七十五毫米 SA38 短管砲（車內備彈約五十發）與一門四十七毫米 SA38 車體機砲，七十五毫米砲初速約每秒四百三十米，全車公路最高速度只有約三十二公里每小時，續航約二百至二百五十公里，乘員編制偏少，砲塔內僅容一人，車長必須兼任炮手，裝填、瞄準與指揮同時壓在一個人身上。其傳動與懸掛系統故障率高、轉向沉重，車體後部無防彈底板；B1 bis 補裝了無線電機，與原始型相比是最早能可靠把命令傳出砲塔的法軍重裝。產量約四百一十三輛，配屬第一、第四與第五裝甲師的戰車營，每營約十六輛，與十輛 R35 類輕型戰車混編成一個戰車連。法軍其餘戰車以 R35、H35、H39 與索瑪 S35 為主力，另有 FT 等舊式車與 AMR 35 裝甲車；反戰車靠四十七毫米反戰車砲與二十五毫米 Hotchkiss 機砲，步兵師配三十七毫米反戰車砲。德軍方面有二號、三號、四號戰車與一號、裝甲砲一、二號突擊車，專用反戰車為三・七厘米 PaK 36、五厘米 KwK 39 與二厘米 Flak 30，四・七厘米 PaK(t) 隨獅子豹步兵師前進；最值得注意的是第八車隊的八輪半履帶車（SD.Kfz. 8）上裝八・八厘米 Flak 36，五月十七日在法國弗雷蒂爾一帶摧毀了數輛 B1 bis，是整場戰役中法軍重裝最著名的單點損失。空軍方面德軍以容克八十七俯衝轟炸機、Ju 88 與 Bf 109 作為突破的空中支柱，法軍則有 MS.225、MB.150 與 D.520 等機型，數量與性能都落在下風。運輸與後勤同樣是戰局的一部分：德軍在比利時與法國境內大量徵用民用車輛運油，仍受制於燃料配額；法軍在六月的汽油配給被削減，戰車連常因缺油而停在路上；敦刻爾克撤離則靠數百艘英法荷船隻與民用船隊的緊急徵用完成。
kitsEn: The tank on the card, the Char B1 bis (B1 bis S35), was the mass-produced French heavy tank produced between 1936 and 1937 by lengthening the hull of the original B1 and thickening its armour. It weighed about thirty-two tonnes, with eighty millimetres of frontal hull armour, forty to fifty millimetres on the sides and sixty to eighty on the turret face. It carried one 75 mm SA38 short-barrel gun with roughly fifty rounds carried in the hull and one 47 mm SA38 machine gun in the hull, the 75 mm firing at about 430 metres per second. Its top road speed was only about 32 km/h and its range some 200 to 250 kilometres, and the crew was small: the turret held a single man, so the commander had to double as gunner, loading, aiming and issuing orders all at once. Transmission and suspension failures were frequent, steering was heavy, and there was no armoured floor over the engine; what the B1 bis added over the original was a radio, which made it the first French heavy tank able to pass orders reliably out of the turret. Around 413 were built, and they were issued to the tank companies of the 1st, 4th and 5th Armoured Divisions, roughly sixteen per company, mixed in the same company with about ten R35-type light tanks. The rest of the French tank force centred on the R35, H35, H39 and SOMUA S35, with older FT tanks and AMR 35 armoured cars in addition; anti-tank work was done with the 47 mm anti-tank gun and the 25 mm Hotchkiss, while infantry divisions carried 37 mm anti-tank guns. On the German side were the Panzer II, III and IV, the Panzer I and the assault guns Jagdpanzer I and II, with 3.7 cm PaK 36, 5 cm KwK 39 and 2 cm Flak 30 as the dedicated anti-tank weapons, while the 4.7 cm PaK(t) travelled forward with the panzergrenadier divisions. The most remarkable single loss of French heavy armour was the work of the 8.8 cm Flak 36 mounted on the eight-wheeled half-tracked Sd.Kfz. 8 of the 8th Motor Brigade, which destroyed a number of B1 bis around La Baraque de Fraiture on 17 May. In the air the Germans based the breakthrough on the Junkers Ju 87 dive bomber, the Ju 88 and the Bf 109, while the French flew the MS.225, MB.150 and D.520, outnumbered and outclassed. Transport and logistics were part of the battle as well: the Germans requisitioned large numbers of civilian lorries in Belgium and France to haul fuel and were still constrained by fuel quotas; French petrol allocations were cut in June, so tank companies often stood still on the road for want of fuel; and the evacuation from Dunkirk was carried by several hundred British, French and Dutch ships plus the emergency requisition of merchant tonnage.
tactics: 德軍的戰術核心是速度、連續與空地協同：裝甲兵團不設後方警戒線，四個師以上的戰車集群在俯衝轟炸機與摩托化步兵保障下連續推進，一旦突破即不停留，戰車團之間保持能互相掩護的緊密距離，部隊一旦停頓就等於把主動權交回對手。法軍則以戴爾計畫把主要兵力推入比利時，用阿登森林的崎嶇地形拖住德軍，裝甲師作為總預備，等德軍主力出現在比利時再行反擊；問題出在通訊與預備隊的位置——裝甲師被拆散分給各軍，砲塔與車體之間沒有可靠無線電連結，命令往往在幾十分鐘後才到達，前線的連級指揮官常常只能靠直覺應戰。戰役過程可以分幾段看：五月十日空襲與全線進攻展開；十三日古德里安的第十九軍團在色丹強渡梅茲河，突破缺口迅速擴大；十五日至十九日卡圖的第四裝甲師以 B1 bis 與 R35 在斯托尼一線死守，把古德里安的戰車兵團拖了數日；二十日戰車兵團抵達亞伯維爾，英法聯軍在博蒙與阿拉斯受挫，聯軍被切成南北兩段；二十一日至二十四日法軍在索姆河與埃納河一線以裝甲師發動反攻，第五與第一裝甲師在此投入 B1 bis，但反攻因缺乏統一命令與預備隊而未能扭轉戰局；二十六日至六月四日敦刻爾克撤離，六月五日盟軍企圖在諾曼第海岸登陸未果，六月十日法軍發動最後一次反攻（玫瑰行動），同日義大利自阿爾卑斯方向進攻，六月十四日巴黎淪陷，十七日貝當組閣，二十二日停戰書簽署。整個過程中，德軍的裝甲推進一旦脫離後方補給就難以為繼，而法軍的防禦在失去預備隊與制空權之後，只剩下逐點抵抗的頑強。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the German offensive was speed, continuity and air-ground cooperation. Armoured formations travelled without a rearward security screen: tank groups of four divisions or more pushed on continuously under the protection of dive bombers and motorised infantry, and once a breach was made they did not pause. Distances between tank formations were kept tight enough to cover one another, because a formation that stopped handed the initiative back to the enemy. The French, by contrast, advanced the bulk of their forces into Belgium under the Dyle Plan, hoping to use the broken country of the Ardennes to slow the Germans, and they held the armoured divisions back as general reserve, to be used once the German main effort appeared in Belgium. The weakness lay in communications and in the position of the reserves: the armoured divisions were broken up and handed out to the individual armies, there was no reliable radio link between turret and hull, orders often took three quarters of an hour to arrive, and regimental and battalion commanders on the front were frequently left to improvise. The campaign can be read in stages. On 10 May the air attacks and the general advance opened. On the 13th Guderian's XIX Army Corps forced the Meuse at Sedan and the breach widened quickly. From the 15th to the 19th Catroux's 4th Armoured Division held at Stonne with B1 bis and R35, holding Guderian's tank force for several days. On the 20th the tank groups reached Abbeville, the Anglo-French forces were checked at Beaumont and Arras, and the Allied armies were cut in two. From the 21st to the 24th the French counter-attacked along the Somme and the Aisne with armoured divisions, the 5th and 1st committing B1 bis, but the counter-attack could not reverse anything because it lacked a common plan and reserves. From 26 May to 4 June came the evacuation from Dunkirk; on 5 June an Allied landing attempt on the Normandy coast failed; on 10 June the French launched their last counter-offensive, Operation Rose, while Italy attacked from the Alps; Paris fell on the 14th, Pétain formed a government on the 17th, and the armistice was signed on the 22nd. Throughout, German armoured momentum broke as soon as the formations outran their supply, while French resistance, once the reserves and air superiority were gone, came down to stubborn resistance at individual points.
data: 戰役自一九四〇年五月十日至六月二十五日，前後四十六天，停戰書在六月二十二日簽署。德軍在西線投入的部隊常見統計為一百三十五個師，另有若干旅團，其中戰車師十個；法軍編有九十四個師，五十六個師配在北部、二十二個師守阿爾卑斯山、十六個師留作總預備，至六月中旬總動員約二百六十萬人（各書統計在二百萬至二百六十萬之間）。戰車方面，法軍在西線可用的坦克約三千二百至三千五百輛，其中可作戰的現代式車約二千七百輛；德軍作戰的裝甲車約五千輛上下（常見引述五千至六千輛）。卡面的 B1 bis 系列產量約四百一十三輛，另有 B1 原始型約二百二十輛，每個戰車營配約十六輛。馬奇諾防線北段長約四百四十公里，阿爾卑斯方向另有一段「小馬奇諾」。法軍陣亡約六萬至八萬五千人、負傷約二十萬人、被俘約一百八十萬人；德軍陣亡約四萬五千至五萬人、負傷約十一萬人、被俘約一萬餘人，各書數字分歧，以法軍損失的各方記載尤其互相矛盾。敦刻爾克撤離自五月二十六日至六月四日，共撤出約三十三萬八千人，用船約八百六十艘。距離上，五月十三日梅茲河被突破到五月二十日德軍抵達亞伯維爾，戰車兵團在七天內推進約二百五十公里，平均每日三十公里以上；然而燃料不足常令車隊夜間停佇，地面步兵的推進速度往往落後戰車數日，法軍在六月的汽油配給同樣被削減。以上多為概數，各方記載尤其對裝甲部隊的損失與俘虜數字互有出入。
dataEn: The campaign ran from 10 May to 25 June 1940, forty-six days in all, with the armistice signed on 22 June. The commonly cited German order of battle in the west is 135 divisions plus a number of brigades, of which ten were panzer divisions. France had ninety-four divisions: fifty-six in the north, twenty-two in the Alps and sixteen in general reserve, with total mobilisation reaching about 2.6 million men by mid-June, published estimates ranging from two million to 2.6 million. In armour, France had roughly 3,200 to 3,500 tanks available in the west, of whom about 2,700 were modern types in serviceable condition; Germany had on the order of five thousand armoured vehicles in action, commonly quoted as five to six thousand. The B1 bis series on the card ran to about 413 vehicles, with roughly a further 220 original B1s, and each tank company received about sixteen of them. The northern stretch of the Maginot Line ran for about 440 kilometres, with a further so-called Little Maginot along the Alpine front. French dead are given as about 60,000 to 85,000, wounded at about 200,000 and prisoners at roughly 1.8 million; German dead at about 45,000 to 50,000, wounded at about 110,000 and prisoners in the region of ten thousand, the published counts differing, and the accounts of French losses especially contradicting one another. The evacuation from Dunkirk ran from 26 May to 4 June, taking out about 338,000 men in some 860 ships. On distances, from the forcing of the Meuse on 13 May to the German arrival at Abbeville on the 20th, the tank groups covered about 250 kilometres in seven days, an average of more than thirty kilometres a day; shortage of fuel nevertheless brought the columns to a halt at night, and the infantry on foot generally trailed the tanks by days, while French petrol allocations were cut in the same way. Most of these are round figures, and the published accounts disagree most sharply over the losses of the armoured formations and over prisoner numbers.
cause: 德國在波蘭與北歐的勝利令它再無東面顧慮，可以把力量全部壓向西線；而法國與英國之間的互助條約、德法邊境沿線長期累積的軍備競賽、萊茵區非軍事化安排的崩解，令一九三〇年代後半的歐洲成了兩套體系的正面對撞。開戰前一年，法國已在國境線上堆起馬奇諾防線，並把希望寄託在慢慢消磨德軍、等美國援助到來的拖延戰上；德軍則認定只要打垮法國，就可解除兩面作戰的隱患，並取得洛林與北法的鐵礦、煤炭與工業產能。法軍總參謀長加勉主張的戴爾計畫把主力推入比利時，用阿登的地形換取時間，而德軍在曼施泰因策劃下恰恰選擇在同一條阿登上正面突破，並以奇襲與空襲癱瘓比法軍的指揮體系。戰前數月的政治氣候同樣重要：法國國內第三共和國的政黨分歧，使軍方在「進攻」與「防守」之間猶豫不決；英國遠征軍雖已進駐法國，卻沒有統一整個聯軍的指揮權；德國則已完成對萊茵與奧地利的兼併，把法國的戰爭經濟與海上封鎖當作必須先解決的問題。五月十日的進攻其實是幾項壓力同時爆發：荷蘭與比利時的中立被德軍直接推翻，義大利在阿爾卑斯方向蓄勢待攻，法國邊境線上的空軍劣勢與裝甲預備隊分散的問題，則在德軍突破的第一天就全部暴露。
causeEn: Germany's victories in Poland and in Scandinavia left it free of eastern commitments and allowed it to concentrate everything on the western front. At the same time the Franco-British treaty of mutual assistance, the long-running arms race along the Franco-German frontier and the collapse of the Rhineland demilitarisation arrangements turned the Europe of the later 1930s into the direct confrontation of two systems. In the year before the war France had built the Maginot Line along its own border and placed its hopes on a war of attrition that would grind the Germans down while waiting for American aid. Germany argued that France had to be beaten to remove the danger of fighting on two fronts, and to take the iron ore, coal and industrial output of Lorraine and the north. The Dyle Plan favoured by Gamelin pushed the main body into Belgium in order to buy time with the Ardennes, and Germany, on Manstein's planning, chose to break through in exactly that same Ardennes while paralysing the Belgian and French command system with surprise and air attack. The political climate of the preceding months mattered as well: the party divisions of the Third Republic left the French military wavering between offence and defence; the British Expeditionary Force was already in France without a unified command over the whole Allied force; and Germany had completed the annexation of the Rhineland and Austria, treating the French war economy and maritime blockade as problems that had to be settled first. The offensive of 10 May was the simultaneous bursting of several pressures: the neutrality of Holland and Belgium was simply overturned, Italy was poised in the Alps, and the French weakness in the air and the dispersal of their armoured reserve were both laid bare on the first day of the German breakthrough.
impact: 法國第三共和國在停戰後名存實亡，貝當政府遷都巴黎，法國被分成北部的佔領區與南部的所謂自由區，佔領線幾乎就是德軍推進所及之處，約佔國土五分之三。停戰條款要求法軍解除武裝，只留警衛與維修部隊，法國海軍在港口被解除武裝，隨後成為軸心國與盟國雙方爭取的對象，一九四二年十一月法軍在土倫集體自行沉船以免落入德軍之手；同時法國被索取每日二千萬法郎的佔領費，經濟與政治都全面依附於征服者。戴高樂在倫敦倡導的「自由法國」則在殖民地與海外維持了國家的另一條血脈，其正當性在戰後成為第四共和國的立國基礎，法國也終於重回聯合國的常任理事國席位。這場戰役在軍事學術上的後果更為深遠：裝甲集中、縱深、速度、以及飛機與戰車的協同，第一次被大規模證明為摧毀既有防線的可行辦法，此後巴巴羅薩作戰與歐洲其他戰役的樣板幾乎都以此為底本。德國得到的卻是一個必須長期鎮壓的廣大佔領地，法國游擊隊與地下抵抗運動在佔領區蔓延，法國的原料供給也遠不如帳面所顯示的順利。對英國而言，敦刻爾克保住了本土與共同體的骨幹，卻在隨後一年裡獨自承擔了對空作戰的全部壓力；對亞洲而言，歐洲宗主國的崩潰直接改變了日本的算計，法屬印度支那在一九四〇年內落入日軍之手，歐洲的注意力全部轉向西方，也讓遠東的侵略者失去了制約。
impactEn: After the armistice the Third Republic existed in name only. The Pétain government moved to Paris and France was split into an occupied zone in the north and a so-called free zone in the south, the line of demarcation running almost exactly to wherever the German advance had reached, and covering about three-fifths of the country. The terms required the French army to disarm, leaving only garrison and maintenance troops; the French navy was disarmed in its ports and became an object of competing German and Allied claims, and in November 1942 the French scuttled their own ships at Toulon rather than let them fall into German hands. France was meanwhile billed an occupation indemnity of some twenty million francs a day, and both its economy and its politics became wholly dependent on the conqueror. The Free France proclaimed by de Gaulle in London kept alive another line of continuity through the colonies and the overseas territories, and its legitimacy became the founding basis of the Fourth Republic after the war; France returned to a permanent seat on the United Nations Security Council. The military consequences were even more far-reaching: armoured concentration, depth, speed, and the cooperation of aircraft with tanks were demonstrated for the first time on a large scale to be workable means of breaching an established line, and the template was carried straight into Barbarossa and the other campaigns of the European war. What Germany received in return was a vast occupied territory that had to be policed indefinitely: the maquis and the underground resistance spread across the occupied zone, and the flow of French raw materials proved far less reliable than the statistics suggested. For Britain, Dunkirk saved the mainland and the backbone of the empire, but the country then bore the whole weight of the air war alone for the following year. In Asia the collapse of a European colonial power changed the Japanese calculation directly, and French Indochina fell to Japanese forces during 1940, while the turn of European attention to the west removed constraints on aggression in the Far East.
result: 六月十七日貝當組閣，十八日宣布停戰談判，法國代表團於二十一日前往簽署地點，二十二日清早在貢比涅的一戰停戰車廂內簽下停戰書，二十五日上午十時生效。條款的核心是：法國軍隊解除武裝，只保留警衛與維修部隊；軸心國佔領法國北部與西部，佔領線大致等於德軍推進所達之處，約佔國土五分之三與北岸西岸的全部海岸；未佔領的南部由貝當政府主持，首都設在維希，國民議會於七月十日以多數票授以全權；法國海軍在港口解除武裝；法軍在未佔領區保留一定數量的武裝部隊；法國每日支付佔領費；法國被俘約一百八十萬名官兵。停戰之後，德軍在西線的戰鬥暫時停止，但倫敦並未投降，敦刻爾克撤回本土的英軍隨後在英吉利海峽與英格蘭上空投入另一場決定性的戰役。對法國本身而言，這場戰爭的結果是主力部隊被解除武裝、國家一分為二、首都淪陷、政權更迭，而對德國而言，代價慘重的勝利換來的是西線的兩年安全，以及接手法國的資源與一個必然反覆的佔領地。裝甲部隊的下場同樣說明戰爭的殘酷：法軍三個裝甲師在此役中損失慘重，B1 bis 幾乎全滅，殘存車輛多被軸心國接收並改裝為拖曳與救護用途。
resultEn: Pétain formed a government on 17 June and announced armistice negotiations on the 18th; the French delegation reached the place of signature on the 21st, and the armistice was signed in the early hours of the 22nd in the railway carriage at Compiègne in which the armistice of 1918 had been signed, taking effect at ten in the morning on the 25th. The heart of the terms was this: the French army would be disarmed, keeping only garrison and maintenance troops; the Axis would occupy the north and the west of France, the line of occupation running roughly to wherever the German advance had reached, some three-fifths of the country together with the whole of the northern and western coasts; the unoccupied south would be governed by the Pétain government, whose capital was transferred to Vichy and which was granted full powers by a majority of the Chamber of Deputies on 10 July; the French navy would be disarmed in its ports; a limited number of French troops would remain armed in the unoccupied zone; France would pay an occupation indemnity daily; and some 1.8 million French soldiers and sailors became prisoners. After the armistice the fighting in the west ceased for the time being, but London did not surrender: the British troops brought back from Dunkirk went on to fight the decisive battle over the Channel and over British skies. For France itself the result was a main army disarmed, a country split in two, a fallen capital and a change of government; for Germany the costly victory bought two years of security in the west, together with the resources of France and an occupied territory certain to remain troublesome. The fate of the armoured formations illustrates the ferocity of the campaign: the three French armoured divisions were badly mauled, the B1 bis were virtually wiped out, and the surviving vehicles passed to the Axis, many of them converted to towing and recovery work.
